## What and why

Describe the change and the reason for it. Link the issue it closes, for
example `Closes #31`.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New editing tool or effect
- [ ] AI or on-device model
- [ ] Build, CI, or platform config
- [ ] Docs

## Checks

- [ ] `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos lib test` passes
- [ ] `flutter test` passes
- [ ] For an FFmpeg change, I added or updated the command-builder unit test
- [ ] `git grep -nE "BEGIN PRIVATE KEY|AIza" -- lib` is empty (no secrets)
- [ ] Core editing still works offline

## Testing

How did you verify this? Note the device and OS if you ran it, since CI does
not run the app on a device.

## Screenshots

If this changes the UI, add before and after images.
